description: RFC 9457 problem codes used by generation, usage and notifications. `origin: existing` codes already exist in Learning (ApiErrorCode) with this status, title, detail and type; `origin: new` codes are added by the AI tasks. Extension members are additive and never echo content, titles or notes. Every problem is application/problem+json, Cache-Control: private, no-store, with type, title, status, detail, instance and code. `endpoints` of a code is exactly the set of http.json operations that list it (checked by GenerationContractFixtureTest); the generic codes marked [all] apply to every operation.
extensionMechanism: ApiErrorCode keeps its fixed status, title and detail. The run-2 tasks add the extension members below through a small typed ProblemExtension map in platform.api; AI-01 (#281) is its first user.
evaluationOrder: 1 authentication and ownership (foreign or unknown IDs, including an unknown or foreign note ID in sources, are 404: no existence oracle); 2 command receipt replay (same commandId and body returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true, before anything else is re-evaluated); 3 request validation (400); 4 preconditions (428, then 412 on If-Match and expected versions); 5 state (409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, 422 limits); 6 usage (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, last, inside the admission transaction). Nothing changes state before step 6 passes.

INVALID_REQUEST.title: Invalid request
INVALID_REQUEST.detail: The request is invalid or cannot be read.
INVALID_REQUEST.when: Strict-JSON, field, UUID, version, cursor, limit or enum violations; also an AI edit target the edit cannot use (reason TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS: not consecutive top-level blocks of the current revision; TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK: MBM cannot express it; TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA: its text holds an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number, which the prompt layer would redact and the rewrite would overwrite; TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY), a preset without REWRITE, an EXERCISE hand-off, an approval replacement that is not a valid exercise about the proposal's subject material (or on an ITEM artifact, or in a bulk entry). A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE spec that cannot be revised, named by reason (createSession): TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK (a material block MBM cannot express, or an exercise the output form has no room for: an image, a video, a YouTube block, a rubric, a speech answer, a quote of another material), TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA (an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number in the text), TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY (a material with no text block), TARGET_NO_AUDIO (a voice change for an exercise without audio; also editArtifact). A bulk approval of a revise session, and an exercise edit that has a target, a REWRITE or REMOVE_MEDIA action, a voice on FREE or no voice on AUDIO_REGENERATE.

extensionMembers.reason: createSession and editArtifact, additive: TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS | TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK | TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA | TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY | TARGET_NO_AUDIO (absent for every other 400)

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.title: Resource not found
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.detail: The requested resource does not exist.
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.when: Foreign or absent deck, session, artifact, revision, notification, purged session; also an unknown or foreign note or material in the sources of a spec (never SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: no existence oracle).

VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Version conflict
VERSION_CONFLICT.detail: The resource changed after the supplied version was read.
VERSION_CONFLICT.when: Stale If-Match, expectedArtifactVersion, expectedRevisionId, expectedDeckRevisionId or (approvePlan) expectedSessionVersion. Read the resource again and retry with a new commandId.

extensionMembers.artifactIds: bulk approval only: the stale artifacts

PRECONDITION_REQUIRED.title: Precondition required
PRECONDITION_REQUIRED.detail: A current resource version is required for this command.
PRECONDITION_REQUIRED.when: Missing If-Match where the endpoint requires it.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.title: Idempotency conflict
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.detail: The command identifier was already used for a different command.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.when: commandId reused with a different body, target or expected versions. An exact retry is not an error: the stored response is replayed with Idempotency-Replayed: true.

RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.title: Resource limit exceeded
RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.detail: The account or resource limit would be exceeded.
RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.when: More than 3 active sessions (PLANNING, PLAN_READY, RUNNING, and REVIEW with a PROPOSED, REVISING or STALE artifact), more than 20 artifacts (MATERIALS) or 60 exercises (EXERCISES) in a session, more than 20 exercise targets or 10 exercises per target, EditingDraft quota on hand-off, more than 50 turns or 30 revisions on one artifact. No silent clamp. Also an edit whose blocks to rewrite exceed the output bound (EDIT_TARGET_SIZE, limits.maxEditTargetTokens). REVISE_ITEM rewrites the whole material in one turn: a material that weighs more than the output bound (EDIT_TARGET_SIZE at createSession); a revise session counts toward the 3 active sessions. approvePlan: a plan the owner edited above 10 exercises per material, 60 exercises or 20 materials (limit EXERCISES_PER_TARGET, EXERCISES_PER_SESSION or ARTIFACTS_PER_SESSION; never clamped).

extensionMembers.limit: ACTIVE_SESSIONS | ARTIFACTS_PER_SESSION | EXERCISE_TARGETS | EXERCISES_PER_TARGET | EXERCISES_PER_SESSION | SOURCES | EDITING_DRAFTS | TURNS_PER_ARTIFACT | REVISIONS_PER_ARTIFACT | EDIT_TARGET_SIZE
extensionMembers.limits: the configured limits that apply, e.g. {maxExerciseTargets: 20, maxExercisesPerTarget: 10, maxExercisesPerSession: 60}
extensionMembers.activeSessionIds: ACTIVE_SESSIONS only: the ids of the active sessions

example.title: Resource limit exceeded
example.detail: The account or resource limit would be exceeded.

SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED.title: Spec not supported
SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED.detail: The generation spec is valid but not supported yet.
SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED.when: settings.planFirst true (MATERIALS or EXERCISES) while the planner is disabled (learning.generation.planner.enabled=false; on by default since AI-14, #295). REVISE_ITEM and REVISE_EXERCISE were refused with it until AI-16 (#294); they are supported now. A new code because 422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED would mislead.

CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Capability unavailable
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The requested learning capability is not available.
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.when: A capability the operation needs is off: flag disabled, adapter not configured, or temporarily unavailable. createIntent needs aiGeneration (also reason TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE when the provider cannot answer); the voice redo of a REVISE_EXERCISE media action needs the Stub speech executor or, later, a real speech adapter (AI-09, #297): without either it is textToSpeech / PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.

extensionMembers.capability: aiGeneration | textToSpeech | imageSearch | imageGeneration | videoGeneration | webSearch | speechToText | aiAssessment

example.title: Capability unavailable
example.detail: The requested learning capability is not available.

notes: The members are additive (AI-02, #282: LearningCapabilities.require* adds them) and the same reason codes appear in GET /api/capabilities. TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE is new (circuit open or global budget).

USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Usage limit reached
USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.detail: The remaining AI budget does not cover this operation.
USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.when: A reservation or debit does not fit a bucket: the credit bar (also its weekly unlock on Free), the daily burst, a count cap (podcasts, quality images, high fact check, smart plan) or a fair-use bucket (speech-to-text, answer checks). The button is never disabled in advance; pressing it shows this outcome with the options. Evaluated last, inside the admission transaction, before any state change.

extensionMembers.bucket: CREDITS | DAILY_BURST | STT | ASSESSMENT | PODCASTS | QUALITY_IMAGES | HIGH_FACTCHECK | SMART_PLAN
extensionMembers.limit: the limit of the bucket in this window (null when unlimited within fair use)
extensionMembers.used: amount used or held in this window
extensionMembers.required: amount this operation needs, in unit
extensionMembers.offered: false: the bucket does not exist on this plan (a cap of 0), waiting never helps
extensionMembers.renewsAt: UTC instant of the next refresh or unlock, null when waiting will not help
extensionMembers.fitsAfterRenewal: boolean: required fits the bucket after renewsAt (false for an operation larger than any Free portion can ever cover)

example.title: Usage limit reached
example.detail: The remaining AI budget does not cover this operation.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Rate limited
RATE_LIMITED.detail: Too many requests; retry after the time in Retry-After.
RATE_LIMITED.when: createIntent more than learning.generation.intent.per-hour (30) times in a rolling hour for one account. A free call, so credits are not the limit; the model is not asked.

extensionMembers.retryAfter: whole seconds until the oldest call of the window leaves it, at least 1; the same number is the Retry-After header

example.title: Rate limited
example.detail: Too many requests; retry after the time in Retry-After.

EDIT_IN_PROGRESS.title: Edit in progress
EDIT_IN_PROGRESS.detail: Another edit of this artifact is still running.
EDIT_IN_PROGRESS.when: editArtifact while a turn of this artifact is QUEUED or RUNNING (artifact state REVISING). One edit per artifact at a time.

example.title: Edit in progress
example.detail: Another edit of this artifact is still running.

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Source unavailable
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: A pinned source is no longer available.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.when: An OWNED pinned note or material exists but its version no longer matches the pin, or it was deleted since (createSession, retryArtifact). An unknown or foreign ID is 404. During a run the same condition is not an HTTP error: the artifact becomes FAILED(SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE) or STALE. A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE target that is no longer the head of its material or exercise (type ITEM or EXERCISE), an exercise whose material was deleted or whose quoted blocks cannot follow the head of its material.

extensionMembers.sources: [{type: NOTE|ITEM|EXERCISE, id}] identifiers of the unavailable pins; ids are the client's own, no titles or text

example.title: Source unavailable
example.detail: A pinned source is no longer available.

GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT.title: Generation state conflict
GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT.detail: The operation is not allowed in the current state.
GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT.when: A command that states.json allowedOperations does not permit in the current session or artifact state (for example approve on a REJECTED artifact, cancel of a CLOSED session), approval while a media slot is neither READY nor REMOVED, approval of a STALE artifact, retry of a REFUSAL failure. Decision beyond the architecture: it names no code for illegal transitions, and 412 is reserved for stale versions. Also editArtifact and revertArtifact on an EXERCISE artifact of an EXERCISES session (only the exercise of a REVISE_EXERCISE session is edited and reverted, AI-16 #294), revertArtifact while a turn runs or to a revision from before the artifact was last retried, and editArtifact on a session that is not RUNNING or REVIEW (a CANCELLED one accepts REMOVE_MEDIA only). A retry of a REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE artifact is reason NOT_RETRYABLE (a stale revision is replaced by a new session, «Ещё раз» is an edit).

extensionMembers.artifactIds: for bulk approval: the artifacts that block it

example.title: Generation state conflict
example.detail: The operation is not allowed in the current state.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Internal error
INTERNAL_ERROR.detail: The request could not be completed.
INTERNAL_ERROR.when: Unexpected failure; the cause is logged, never returned.

notFoundBoundary: A foreign owner and an absent ID are indistinguishable (404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED and CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE are 409 because the request is valid and the state of the account or the server decides.

artifactErrorCodes.note: Non-HTTP codes stored on a FAILED artifact or step and carried in ARTIFACT_STATE.errorCode.

mbmCodes.note: Compile findings are returned inside artifact validation, never as an HTTP problem.

exerciseLintCodes.note: Exercise validation findings; stored in revision.validation, never an HTTP problem.
